chapter.title: Experiment of the Power of Nirvana

body: As soon as the matter with the Hunter Guild was settled, ※9⛬ didn't let himself idle.
He was full of curiosity and anticipation, single-mindedly beginning to experiment with the miraculous ※2⛬ on ※8⛬, hoping to use this power to clear the energy channels within ※8⛬'s body.
In the beginning, ※9⛬'s brows were always tightly furrowed, his eyes filled with worry, and he kept muttering to himself, "Will doing this actually harm ※8⛬?"
To ensure absolute safety, he specifically took ※8⛬ to the ※1⛬ and found ※10⛬ to help with a thorough examination.
※10⛬'s gentle voice echoed in the ※1⛬, "※9⛬, your ※8⛬ is really well-trained! How did you train him? He's so healthy and doesn't have any hidden injuries.
Which breeder helped you take care of him?"
※9⛬'s heart skipped a beat, and he stammered a few vague sentences, finding a random excuse to gloss over the matter.
Fortunately, the examination results showed that ※8⛬ was completely normal, and only then did ※9⛬ completely relax.
After that, ※9⛬ began to clear the energy channels.
However, he was very careful, as this matter concerned ※8⛬'s physical condition.
※9⛬ discovered that the large energy channels were simply too big; with his current ※2⛬, there was no way he could clear them all at once.
What was even stranger was that if a channel wasn't completely cleared in one go, the next time he checked, that channel would be blocked again.
This puzzled ※9⛬ greatly, and he scratched his head, muttering with a bewildered expression, "What on earth is going on?"

Originally, he had thought that if a large channel couldn't be cleared at once, he could just take his time, but now it seemed completely unfeasible; the speed of slow clearing simply couldn't keep up with the speed of the channels getting blocked.
In fact, ※9⛬ had once hoped that he could use this ※2⛬ to unblock those blocked channels one by one, allowing ※8⛬'s aptitude to be infinitely improved, making him an incredibly powerful ※4⛬.
However, reality was like a heavy blow, mercilessly shattering his illusions.
He knew that if his own ※2⛬ could not grow further, then at most he could only try to unblock some small channels and slightly smaller medium channels within ※8⛬'s body.
As a result, even if ※8⛬ could improve his aptitude to a certain extent, many large channels would still remain unblocked within his body.
According to ※9⛬'s ※3⛬ estimation, if all small channels could be successfully unblocked, ※8⛬'s aptitude might be elevated to ※0⛬;
if all medium channels were also unobstructed, his aptitude was expected to reach ※5⛬;
and if those large channels could also be completely unblocked, perhaps ※8⛬ could even enter the ranks of ※6⛬ or even ※6⛬.
However, ※9⛬ also knew in his heart that this was merely the calculation result made by the ※3⛬ based on the current condition of the channels within ※8⛬'s body.
Due to the extreme lack of experimental data, its accuracy could not be guaranteed, and at best it could only serve as a reference, not to be taken entirely seriously.
Not only that, but ※9⛬ also secretly speculated that in this ※4⛬ world, apart from those divine beasts with extraordinary power, the aptitude limit for ordinary ※4⛬ might be ※7⛬.
It was just that he had never had the opportunity to witness what the energy channels within a ※7⛬ ※4⛬ truly looked like, nor was he sure if they were truly all connected.

"If the channels within a ※7⛬ ※4⛬ are indeed all clear, then it means my conjecture is correct, that is, only when the internal energy channels are completely connected can a ※4⛬'s aptitude reach ※7⛬.
If that's truly the case, then I will have a clear direction and goal."
※9⛬ mused silently in his heart.
But this was ultimately just his guess; before it could be definitively confirmed, everything remained unknown, and perhaps other unknown secrets and mysteries were hidden within.
※9⛬ knew clearly that his current ※2⛬ was extremely limited, so he could only temporarily focus his energy on the small channels and slightly smaller medium channels.
Each time he performed a clearing operation, he would pay close attention to his own energy consumption, daring not to be careless in the slightest.
After all, he had a deeply memorable experience.
That time, he accidentally completely depleted his ※2⛬.

In an instant, his face turned as pale as paper, his lips were bloodless, large beads of sweat continuously rolled down his forehead, and his body felt as if all strength had been drained, weakly collapsing to the ground.
That uncomfortable feeling made him feel as if he was about to step into the abyss of death.
Although his ※2⛬ miraculously recovered the next day, the painful taste was deeply imprinted in his memory, making him fearful of exhausting his ※2⛬ from then on, daring not to easily try again.
Currently, ※9⛬ unblocks approximately eight small energy channels for ※8⛬ each day.
This way, he can still retain about 20% of his energy, preventing himself from falling into an extremely uncomfortable state.
And the remaining energy has no small use.
Whenever ※8⛬ completes his training, ※9⛬ uses this energy to treat him.
With a focused and determined gaze, he gently placed his hands on ※8⛬'s body, softly saying, "※8⛬, bear with it a little longer, it'll be over soon."
The gentle energy slowly infused into ※8⛬'s body.
※8⛬ comfortably narrowed his eyes, letting out a low purr, as if expressing his inner comfort and satisfaction: "This feeling is truly wonderful."
After such treatment, the fatigue and soreness on ※8⛬'s body instantly vanished without a trace, and no hidden injuries or potential issues were left behind.
Since acquiring this ※2⛬, ※9⛬ clearly felt that training ※8⛬ had become much easier.
In the past, he was always cautious, not daring to let ※8⛬ overtrain, even with the help of the ※3⛬, he was very careful when training, fearing damage to his body.
Because once injured, treatment would be extremely troublesome.
Not only would it affect training time, but it would also cost a lot of money.
But now the situation was completely different, ※9⛬ secretly thought, "Since I can heal him using ※2⛬, then let him train to his heart's content, without too many worries."
Looking at ※8⛬, he was truly exhausted during this period.
After each training session, he would be panting, lying on the ground, his tongue hanging out, breathing heavily.
His originally incredibly sharp and majestic spikes now seemed to have lost their former spirit, drooping limply.
He constantly complained in his heart, "Oh, ever since Master returned from the forest, he's like a changed person, becoming so strict and terrifying.
He makes me, the little mouse, train desperately every day, it's practically killing me."
However, he also knew very well in his heart that his Master was doing all this for his own good.
He understood that only by training harder and continuously improving his strength could he better protect his Master in the future and guard their bond.

Moreover, whenever his Master used that miraculous and comfortable energy to massage and treat him, ※8⛬ felt incredibly happy and satisfied; that feeling of pleasure even surpassed the ※10⛬ brought by the improvement in his strength.
Therefore, even though the training process was exceptionally arduous, ※8⛬ never showed the slightest retreat or slackness, always gritting his teeth and persevering.

And sure enough, in just one short week, whether it was ※9⛬'s ※2⛬ playing a crucial role or the result of ※8⛬'s own hard training, his strength actually soared like a rocket, increasing by a full three levels.
This speed is almost comparable to the rapid growth in strength of a newborn ※4⛬, truly astonishing and delightful, earning endless praise.
What made ※9⛬ even more ecstatic was that through the system, he discovered that as long as he frequently used ※2⛬, it would slightly increase the next day, like a seedling breaking through the soil.
"This is simply amazing!" ※9⛬ thought excitedly.
"If things continue to develop like this, my ※2⛬ will inevitably grow stronger day by day.

At that time, I will have enough ability to unblock all the channels within ※8⛬'s body at once, and no longer have to worry about the awkward situation of giving up halfway and the channels becoming blocked again."
data.title: Chapter 12 Experiments with the Power of Nirvana
